Lesson 18 Text 1: 在打电话 (On the phone)
老周，我打算买房子了，想向你借点儿钱。 (Lǎo Zhōu, wǒ dǎsuàn mǎi fángzi le, xiǎng xiàng nǐ jiè diǎnr qián.) - Lao Zhou, I plan to buy a house and would like to borrow some money from you.
没问题，只要我有，就一定会借给你的。 (Méi wèntí, zhǐyào wǒ yǒu, jiù yídìng huì jiè gěi nǐ de.) - No problem. As long as I have it, I will definitely lend it to you.
还差多少？ (Hái chà duōshao?) - How much are you still short?
还差5万块钱。 (Hái chà wǔ wàn kuài qián.) - I'm still 50,000 yuan short.
好，钱下午打给你。 (Hǎo, qián xiàwǔ dǎ gěi nǐ.) - OK, I'll transfer the money to you this afternoon.
你打算在哪儿买房？ (Nǐ dǎsuàn zài nǎr mǎi fáng?) - Where do you plan to buy a house?
就在我们医院前面。 (Jiù zài wǒmen yīyuàn qiánmian.) - Right in front of our hospital.
那你以后去医院就方便了。 (Nà nǐ yǐhòu qù yīyuàn jiù fāngbiàn le.) - Then it will be convenient for you to go to the hospital in the future.
Lesson 18 Text 2: 在商店 (In a store)

妈妈，你看那只狗多可爱，眼睛大大的，嘴小小的，我们买回去吧。 (Māma, nǐ kàn nà zhī gǒu duō kě'ài, yǎnjing dàdà de, zuǐ xiǎoxiǎo de, wǒmen mǎi huiqu ba.) - Mom, look how cute that dog is, with big eyes and a small mouth. Let's buy it and take it home.
动物和小孩儿一样，都需要人照顾。 (Dòngwù hé xiǎoháir yíyàng, dōu xūyào rén zhàogù.) - Animals are just like children; they all need someone to look after them.
买回家去，谁照顾它啊？ (Mǎi hui jiā qu, shéi zhàogù tā a?) - If we buy it and take it home, who will look after it?
我照顾啊。 (Wǒ zhàogù a.) - I will look after it.
这段时间你自己的衣服都没洗，你能照顾好它吗？ (Zhè duàn shíjiān nǐ zìjǐ de yīfu dōu méi xǐ, nǐ néng zhàogù hǎo tā ma?) - You haven't even washed your own clothes during this period; can you take good care of it?
只要你给我买，我就能照顾好它。 (Zhǐyào nǐ gěi wǒ mǎi, wǒ jiù néng zhàogù hǎo tā.) - As long as you buy it for me, I can take good care of it.
Lesson 18 Text 3: 在公司 (In the company)
说说你为什么选择来我们公司工作。 (Shuōshuo nǐ wèi shénme xuǎnzé lái wǒmen gōngsī gōngzuò.) - Tell me why you chose to come and work at our company.
贵公司不但很有名，而且工作环境好。 (Guì gōngsī búdàn hěn yǒumíng, érqiě gōngzuò huánjìng hǎo.) - Your company is not only very famous, but also has a good working environment.
做这个工作有点儿累，需要经常去外地。 (Zuò zhège gōngzuò yǒudiǎnr lèi, xūyào jīngcháng qù wàidì.) - This job is a bit tiring and requires frequent travel to other places.
你家人同意吗？ (Nǐ jiārén tóngyì ma?) - Does your family agree?
只要我愿意，我相信他们就会同意的。 (Zhǐyào wǒ yuànyì, wǒ xiāngxìn tāmen jiù huì tóngyì de.) - As long as I'm willing, I believe they will agree.
好，那你明天来上班吧。 (Hǎo, nà nǐ míngtiān lái shàng bān ba.) - Good, then come to work tomorrow.
关于这个工作，还有什么问题吗？ (Guānyú zhège gōngzuò, hái yǒu shénme wèntí ma?) - Regarding this job, do you have any other questions?
没有了，谢谢您给我这个机会，我会努力的。 (Méiyǒu le, xièxie nín gěi wǒ zhège jīhuì, wǒ huì nǔlì de.) - No, thank you for giving me this opportunity; I will work hard.
Lesson 18 Text 4: 不同的国家有不同的文化 (Different countries have different cultures)
不同的国家有不同的文化，每种文化都有自己的特点。 (Bùtóng de guójiā yǒu bùtóng de wénhuà, měi zhǒng wénhuà dōu yǒu zìjǐ de tèdiǎn.) - Different countries have different cultures, and every culture has its own features.

到了一个新环境，你会觉得什么都很新鲜，而且还会觉得有点奇怪：有些国家的人名写在姓前面，有些国家的人名写在姓后面，但是只要经过一段时间，就会慢慢地习惯。 (Dàole yí ge xīn huánjìng, nǐ huì juéde shénme dōu hěn xīnxiān, érqiě hái huì juéde yǒudiǎnr qíguài: yǒuxiē guójiā de rénmíng xiě zài xìng qiánmiàn, yǒuxiē guójiā de rénmíng xiě zài xìng hòumiàn, dànshì zhǐyào jīngguò yí duàn shíjiān, jiù huì mànman de xíguàn.) - When you arrive in a new environment, everything feels fresh and you will also find it a little strange: in some countries personal names are written before the surname, in others after it, but as long as some time passes, you will slowly get used to it.
只要我有时间，就一定跟你去旅游。 (Zhǐyào wǒ yǒu shíjiān, jiù yídìng gēn nǐ qù lǚyóu.) - As long as I have time, I will definitely go traveling with you.
我只要喜欢，就一定会买。 (Wǒ zhǐyào xǐhuan, jiù yídìng huì mǎi.) - As long as I like it, I will definitely buy it.
只要你想去，我就跟你去。 (Zhǐyào nǐ xiǎng qù, wǒ jiù gēn nǐ qù.) - As long as you want to go, I will go with you.
只要你给我买，我就能照顾好它。 (Zhǐyào nǐ gěi wǒ mǎi, wǒ jiù néng zhàogù hǎo tā.) - As long as you buy it for me, I can take good care of it.
我最近看了一些关于中国文化的电影。 (Wǒ zuìjìn kànle yìxiē guānyú Zhōngguó wénhuà de diànyǐng.) - Recently I watched some films about Chinese culture.
关于这件事，我们还没有决定呢。 (Guānyú zhè jiàn shì, wǒmen hái méiyǒu juédìng ne.) - Regarding this matter, we haven't decided yet.
关于出国学习的事，妈妈已经同意了。 (Guānyú chūguó xuéxí de shì, māma yǐjīng tóngyì le.) - As for studying abroad, Mom has already agreed.
关于这个工作，还有什么问题吗？ (Guānyú zhège gōngzuò, hái yǒu shénme wèntí ma?) - Regarding this job, do you have any other questions?
动物和小孩儿一样，都需要人照顾。 (Dòngwù hé xiǎoháir yíyàng, dōu xūyào rén zhàogù.) - Animals are just like children; they all need someone to look after them.
他同意了。 (Tā tóngyì le.) - He agreed.
他不同意这件事。 (Tā bù tóngyì zhè jiàn shì.) - He doesn't agree with this matter.
你家人同意吗？ (Nǐ jiārén tóngyì ma?) - Does your family agree?
谢谢您给我这个机会。 (Xièxie nín gěi wǒ zhège jīhuì.) - Thank you for giving me this opportunity.
你喜欢喝哪种茶？ (Nǐ xǐhuan hē nǎ zhǒng chá?) - Which kind of tea do you like to drink?
每种文化都有自己的特点。 (Měi zhǒng wénhuà dōu yǒu zìjǐ de tèdiǎn.) - Every culture has its own features.
只要经过一段时间，就会慢慢地习惯的。 (Zhǐyào jīngguò yí duàn shíjiān, jiù huì mànman de xíguàn de.) - As long as some time passes, you will slowly get used to it.
我也不想迟到，但是家太远了。 (Wǒ yě bù xiǎng chídào, dànshì jiā tài yuǎn le.) - I don't want to be late either, but my home is too far away.
你喜欢看哪种电影？ (Nǐ xǐhuan kàn nǎ zhǒng diànyǐng?) - Which kind of film do you like to watch?
太好了，那你借给我一些吧。 (Tài hǎo le, nà nǐ jiè gěi wǒ yìxiē ba.) - Great, then lend me some.
周末我们去哪儿玩儿？ (Zhōumò wǒmen qù nǎr wánr?) - Where shall we go for fun at the weekend?
经常爬山对身体好。 (Jīngcháng pá shān duì shēntǐ hǎo.) - Climbing mountains often is good for the body.
你还没有吃饱啊？ (Nǐ hái méiyǒu chībǎo a?) - Haven't you had enough to eat yet?
朋友为什么要跟周明借钱？ (Péngyou wèi shénme yào gēn Zhōu Míng jiè qián?) - Why does the friend want to borrow money from Zhou Ming?
小明想买什么？为什么？ (Xiǎomíng xiǎng mǎi shénme? Wèi shénme?) - What does Xiaoming want to buy? Why?
小明的妈妈同意小明的要求了吗？ (Xiǎomíng de māma tóngyì Xiǎomíng de yāoqiú le ma?) - Did Xiaoming's mother agree to Xiaoming's request?
学生愿意来这个公司工作吗？为什么？ (Xuésheng yuànyì lái zhège gōngsī gōngzuò ma? Wèi shénme?) - Is the student willing to work at this company? Why?
经理觉得这个工作怎么样？ (Jīnglǐ juéde zhège gōngzuò zěnmeyàng?) - What does the manager think of this job?
为什么有的人到了一个新环境会觉得有些奇怪？ (Wèi shénme yǒu de rén dàole yí ge xīn huánjìng huì juéde yǒuxiē qíguài?) - Why do some people feel it a bit strange when they arrive in a new environment?
你了解中国历史吗？ (Nǐ liǎojiě Zhōngguó lìshǐ ma?) - Do you know about Chinese history?
关于中国历史，我了解得不多。 (Guānyú Zhōngguó lìshǐ, wǒ liǎojiě de bù duō.) - As for Chinese history, I don't know much.
你了解中国电影吗？ (Nǐ liǎojiě Zhōngguó diànyǐng ma?) - Do you know about Chinese films?
你了解中国音乐吗？ (Nǐ liǎojiě Zhōngguó yīnyuè ma?) - Do you know about Chinese music?
你了解中国人的生活习惯吗？ (Nǐ liǎojiě Zhōngguó rén de shēnghuó xíguàn ma?) - Do you know about the living habits of Chinese people?
你了解中国的节日吗？ (Nǐ liǎojiě Zhōngguó de jiérì ma?) - Do you know about Chinese festivals?
你了解中国汉字文化吗？ (Nǐ liǎojiě Zhōngguó Hànzì wénhuà ma?) - Do you know about Chinese character culture?
我现在身体不太好，常常感冒。 (Wǒ xiànzài shēntǐ bú tài hǎo, chángcháng gǎnmào.) - My health isn't very good now; I often catch colds.
只要你常去锻炼，身体就会慢慢好的。 (Zhǐyào nǐ cháng qù duànliàn, shēntǐ jiù huì mànman hǎo de.) - As long as you exercise often, your health will gradually get better.
只要你注意休息，身体就会很好。 (Zhǐyào nǐ zhùyì xiūxi, shēntǐ jiù huì hěn hǎo.) - As long as you pay attention to resting, your health will be very good.
只要你早睡早起，身体就会好的。 (Zhǐyào nǐ zǎo shuì zǎo qǐ, shēntǐ jiù huì hǎo de.) - As long as you go to bed early and get up early, your health will get better.
奇怪的事物看得多了，习惯了，也就不觉得奇怪了。 (Qíguài de shìwù kàn de duō le, xíguàn le, yě jiù bù juéde qíguài le.) - When you have seen many strange things and got used to them, you no longer find them strange.
Lesson 19 Text 1: 在家 (At home)
女儿最近喜欢把头发放在耳朵后面，你知道为什么吗？ (Nǚ'ér zuìjìn xǐhuan bǎ tóufa fàng zài ěrduo hòumiàn, nǐ zhīdào wèi shénme ma?) - Our daughter likes to put her hair behind her ears lately; do you know why?
这样可以使她的脸看上去漂亮一些。 (Zhèyàng kěyǐ shǐ tā de liǎn kàn shangqu piàoliang yìxiē.) - This can make her face look a bit prettier.
我最近觉得她和以前不太一样了。 (Wǒ zuìjìn juéde tā hé yǐqián bú tài yíyàng le.) - Lately I feel she isn't quite the same as before.

女儿变化不小，她小时候喜欢短头发，像男孩子一样。 (Nǚ'ér biànhuà bù xiǎo, tā xiǎo shíhou xǐhuan duǎn tóufa, xiàng nán háizi yíyàng.) - Our daughter has changed quite a lot; when she was little she liked short hair, like a boy.
我也想起来了。 (Wǒ yě xiǎng qilai le.) - I've remembered it too.
她现在慢慢地开始像个女孩子了。 (Tā xiànzài mànmàn de kāishǐ xiàng ge nǚ háizi le.) - She is now slowly starting to be like a girl.
Lesson 19 Text 2: 在看照片 (Looking at a photo)

上次我们参加骑马比赛的照片，我选了几张洗出来了。 (Shàng cì wǒmen cānjiā qí mǎ bǐsài de zhàopiàn, wǒ xuǎnle jǐ zhāng xǐ chulai le.) - I chose a few photos from the horse-riding competition we took part in last time and had them printed.
快给我看看。 (Kuài gěi wǒ kànkan.) - Quick, let me see.
骑得最快的这位是谁？ (Qí de zuì kuài de zhè wèi shì shéi?) - Who is this person who rode the fastest?
你没看出来吗？ (Nǐ méi kàn chulai ma?) - Didn't you recognise him?
他是小刚啊。 (Tā shì Xiǎogāng a.) - It's Xiaogang.
怎么看上去跟现在不太一样？ (Zěnme kàn shangqu gēn xiànzài bú tài yíyàng?) - Why does he look not quite the same as now?
他上班穿西服、衬衫，比赛的时候穿的是运动服。 (Tā shàng bān chuān xīfú, chènshān, bǐsài de shíhou chuān de shì yùndòngfú.) - He wears a suit and shirt to work, and wore sportswear during the competition.

他今天穿蓝西服，看上去像40多岁，还是穿运动服让他更年轻。 (Tā jīntiān chuān lán xīfú, kàn shangqu xiàng sìshí duō suì, háishi chuān yùndòngfú ràng tā gèng niánqīng.) - Today he is wearing a blue suit and looks about 40; wearing sportswear still makes him look younger.
Lesson 19 Text 3: 在小丽家 (At Xiaoli's home)
我们一年没见面了吧？ (Wǒmen yì nián méi jiàn miàn le ba?) - We haven't seen each other for a year, have we?
听说你都有女儿了？ (Tīngshuō nǐ dōu yǒu nǚ'ér le?) - I heard you even have a daughter now?
她多大了？ (Tā duō dà le?) - How old is she?
她去年秋天出生的，刚过完一岁生日。 (Tā qùnián qiūtiān chūshēng de, gāng guòwán yí suì shēngrì.) - She was born last autumn and has just had her first birthday.
她喜欢什么？我送给她。 (Tā xǐhuan shénme? Wǒ sònggěi tā.) - What does she like? I'll give it to her.
她就喜欢听她爸爸学鸟叫。 (Tā jiù xǐhuan tīng tā bàba xué niǎo jiào.) - She just likes listening to her dad imitating birds.
哭的时候，只要他爸爸学小鸟叫，她马上就安静下来了。 (Kū de shíhou, zhǐyào tā bàba xué xiǎo niǎo jiào, tā mǎshàng jiù ānjìng xialai le.) - When she cries, as long as her dad imitates a little bird, she quiets down immediately.
啊？这个礼物我没办法送。 (Á? Zhège lǐwù wǒ méi bànfǎ sòng.) - Huh? I can't give this gift.
Lesson 19 Text 4: 旅游 (A trip)
这次旅游，我去了不少地方，每个地方都让我非常难忘。 (Zhè cì lǚyóu, wǒ qùle bù shǎo dìfang, měi ge dìfang dōu ràng wǒ fēicháng nánwàng.) - On this trip I went to quite a few places, and every place was unforgettable to me.

我先去看了黄河，黄河是中国有名的大河，我坐在船上，一边看一边照相。 (Wǒ xiān qù kànle Huáng Hé, Huáng Hé shì Zhōngguó yǒumíng de dà hé, wǒ zuò zài chuán shang, yìbiān kàn yìbiān zhào xiàng.) - I first went to see the Yellow River, a famous big river in China; I sat on a boat, looking and taking photos at the same time.
一路上经过了很多地方，每个地方都不一样。 (Yí lù shang jīngguòle hěn duō dìfang, měi ge dìfang dōu bù yíyàng.) - Along the way we passed many places, and each place was different.
我想快点儿把照片发给大家，叫朋友们也高兴高兴。 (Wǒ xiǎng kuài diǎnr bǎ zhàopiàn fāgěi dàjiā, jiào péngyoumen yě gāoxìng gāoxìng.) - I want to send the photos to everyone quickly and make my friends happy too.
这个字你能写出来吗？ (Zhège zì nǐ néng xiě chulai ma?) - Can you write this character out?
朋友想出来一个学汉语的好办法。 (Péngyou xiǎng chulai yí ge xué Hànyǔ de hǎo bànfǎ.) - My friend came up with a good way to learn Chinese.
你画得真快，一会儿就画出来了。 (Nǐ huà de zhēn kuài, yíhuìr jiù huà chulai le.) - You draw really fast; you drew it in no time.
照片我选了几张洗出来了。 (Zhàopiàn wǒ xuǎnle jǐ zhāng xǐ chulai le.) - I chose a few of the photos and had them printed.
你听出来了吗？这是谁的声音？ (Nǐ tīng chulai le ma? Zhè shì shéi de shēngyīn?) - Can you tell by listening? Whose voice is this?
我看出来了，这是二年级的那个女孩子。 (Wǒ kàn chulai le, zhè shì èr niánjí de nàge nǚ háizi.) - I can tell; this is that girl from the second grade.
我喝不出来这两杯咖啡有什么不一样。 (Wǒ hē bu chulai zhè liǎng bēi kāfēi yǒu shénme bù yíyàng.) - I can't tell by tasting what is different about these two cups of coffee.
你没看出来吗？他是小刚啊。 (Nǐ méi kàn chulai ma? Tā shì Xiǎogāng a.) - Can't you tell? He is Xiaogang.
前边的车越开越慢，停下来了。 (Qiánbian de chē yuè kāi yuè màn, tíng xialai le.) - The car in front drove more and more slowly and stopped.
天黑下来了，孩子们要回家了。 (Tiān hēi xialai le, háizimen yào huí jiā le.) - It has gotten dark, and the children are going home.
我真希望时间能慢下来，不要过得那么快。 (Wǒ zhēn xīwàng shíjiān néng màn xialai, bú yào guò de nàme kuài.) - I really hope time can slow down and not pass so quickly.
只要他爸爸学小鸟叫，她马上就安静下来了。 (Zhǐyào tā bàba xué xiǎo niǎo jiào, tā mǎshàng jiù ānjìng xialai le.) - As long as her dad imitates a little bird, she quiets down immediately.
你记起来我是谁了吗？ (Nǐ jì qilai wǒ shì shéi le ma?) - Have you remembered who I am?
你能想起来那是什么时候的事吗？ (Nǐ néng xiǎng qilai nà shì shénme shíhou de shì ma?) - Can you recall when that was?
对不起，我想不起来你的名字了。 (Duìbuqǐ, wǒ xiǎng bu qilai nǐ de míngzi le.) - Sorry, I can't remember your name.
我想起来了，她小时候像个男孩子。 (Wǒ xiǎng qilai le, tā xiǎo shíhou xiàng ge nán háizi.) - I remember now; when she was little she was like a boy.
把头发放在耳朵后边，可以使脸看上去漂亮一些。 (Bǎ tóufa fàng zài ěrduo hòubian, kěyǐ shǐ liǎn kàn shangqu piàoliang yìxiē.) - Putting your hair behind your ears can make your face look a bit prettier.
他今天穿蓝西服，看上去像40多岁。 (Tā jīntiān chuān lán xīfú, kàn shangqu xiàng sìshí duō suì.) - Today he is wearing a blue suit and looks about 40.
这是你做的饭吗？看起来很好吃。 (Zhè shì nǐ zuò de fàn ma? Kàn qilai hěn hǎochī.) - Is this the meal you made? It looks delicious.
他今天一句话也没说，看起来有点儿不高兴。 (Tā jīntiān yí jù huà yě méi shuō, kàn qilai yǒudiǎnr bù gāoxìng.) - He didn't say a word today and seems a bit unhappy.
读书使我快乐。 (Dúshū shǐ wǒ kuàilè.) - Reading makes me happy.
考试让我很紧张。 (Kǎoshì ràng wǒ hěn jǐnzhāng.) - Exams make me very nervous.
穿运动服让他更年轻。 (Chuān yùndòngfú ràng tā gèng niánqīng.) - Wearing sportswear makes him look younger.
我想快点儿把照片发给大家，叫朋友们也高兴高兴。 (Wǒ xiǎng kuài diǎnr bǎ zhàopiàn fāgěi dàjiā, jiào péngyoumen yě gāoxìng gāoxìng.) - I want to send the photos to everyone quickly and make my friends happy too.
她小时候喜欢短头发。 (Tā xiǎoshíhou xǐhuan duǎn tóufa.) - When she was little she liked short hair.
他今天穿蓝西服，看上去像40多岁。 (Tā jīntiān chuān lán xīfú, kàn shàngqù xiàng sìshí duō suì.) - Today he is wearing a blue suit and looks about 40.
她刚过完一岁生日。 (Tā gāng guòwán yí suì shēngrì.) - She has just had her first birthday.
我坐在船上一边看（黄河），一边照相。 (Wǒ zuò zài chuán shang yìbiān kàn (Huánghé), yìbiān zhàoxiàng.) - I sat on the boat, looking (at the Yellow River) and taking photos at the same time.
一路上经过了很多地方。 (Yílù shang jīngguòle hěn duō dìfang.) - Along the way we passed many places.
我想家了。 (Wǒ xiǎng jiā le.) - I miss home.
行，没问题。 (Xíng, méi wèntí.) - OK, no problem.
您好，我们一共是五个人。 (Nín hǎo, wǒmen yígòng shì wǔ gè rén.) - Hello, there are five of us altogether.
不会，我从来没骑过。 (Bú huì, wǒ cónglái méi qíguo.) - No, I have never ridden one.
昨天晚上没休息好。 (Zuótiān wǎnshang méi xiūxi hǎo.) - I didn't rest well last night.
怎么了？ (Zěnme le?) - What's wrong?
你快点儿回家吧。 (Nǐ kuài diǎnr huí jiā ba.) - Hurry up and go home.
你能送我回去吗？ (Nǐ néng sòng wǒ huíqu ma?) - Can you take me back?
没问题。 (Méi wèntí.) - No problem.
阿姨，我是大卫啊！ (Āyí, wǒ shì Dàwèi a!) - Auntie, it's David!
几年没见了，我真看不出来了。 (Jǐ nián méi jiàn le, wǒ zhēn kàn bu chulai le.) - We haven't seen each other for years; I really can't recognise you.
您跟以前一样年轻！ (Nín gēn yǐqián yíyàng niánqīng!) - You are as young as before!
外边雨那么大，你怎么才回来？ (Wàibian yǔ nàme dà, nǐ zěnme cái huílai?) - It's raining so hard outside; why are you only getting back now?
忙了一天了，想吃点儿什么？ (Mángle yì tiān le, xiǎng chī diǎnr shénme?) - You've been busy all day; what would you like to eat?
今天下雨，有点儿冷，吃碗热面条吧。 (Jīntiān xià yǔ, yǒudiǎnr lěng, chī wǎn rè miàntiáo ba.) - It's raining today and a bit cold; let's have a bowl of hot noodles.
女儿最近有什么变化？ (Nǚ'ér zuìjìn yǒu shénme biànhuà?) - What changes has the daughter had lately?
同事为什么没看出来照片里的小刚？ (Tóngshì wèi shénme méi kàn chulai zhàopiàn li de Xiǎogāng?) - Why didn't the colleague recognise Xiaogang in the photo?
小刚上班穿什么？看上去怎么样？ (Xiǎogāng shàng bān chuān shénme? Kàn shangqu zěnmeyàng?) - What does Xiaogang wear to work? How does he look?
小丽为什么说她不能送朋友女儿喜欢的礼物？ (Xiǎolì wèi shénme shuō tā bù néng sòng péngyou nǚ'ér xǐhuan de lǐwù?) - Why does Xiaoli say she cannot give the gift the friend's daughter likes?
“我”觉得这次旅行怎么样？ (“Wǒ” juéde zhè cì lǚxíng zěnmeyàng?) - What does 'I' think of this trip?
“我”想给大家看什么？为什么？ (“Wǒ” xiǎng gěi dàjiā kàn shénme? Wèi shénme?) - What does 'I' want to show everyone? Why?

最近我一直努力学习，考试考得很好，妈妈送给我一个照相机，让我很高兴，我以后会更努力的。 (Zuìjìn wǒ yìzhí nǔlì xuéxí, kǎoshì kǎo de hěn hǎo, māma sòng gěi wǒ yí ge zhàoxiàngjī, ràng wǒ hěn gāoxìng, wǒ yǐhòu huì gèng nǔlì de.) - Recently I have been studying hard and did very well in the exam; Mom gave me a camera, which made me very happy, and I will work even harder in the future.
听见一百次不如亲眼看到一次。 (Tīngjiàn yì bǎi cì bùrú qīnyǎn kàndào yí cì.) - Hearing something a hundred times is not as good as seeing it once with your own eyes.
亲眼看到的总是比听别人说的更可靠。 (Qīnyǎn kàndào de zǒngshì bǐ tīng biérén shuō de gèng kěkào.) - What you see with your own eyes is always more reliable than what you hear others say.
Lesson 20 Text 1: 在休息室 (In the lounge)
我的照相机被谁拿走了？ (Wǒ de zhàoxiàngjī bèi shéi názǒu le?) - Who has taken my camera?
怎么找不到了？ (Zěnme zhǎo bu dào le?) - Why can't I find it?
你再找找。 (Nǐ zài zhǎozhao.) - Look again.
是不是没带来？ (Shì bu shì méi dàilai?) - Maybe you didn't bring it?
我找了，没找到啊。 (Wǒ zhǎo le, méi zhǎodào a.) - I looked, but I didn't find it.

别难过，再买一个吧，公司东门外不就有一个大商场吗？ (Bié nánguò, zài mǎi yí ge ba, gōngsī dōngmén wài bú jiù yǒu yí ge dà shāngchǎng ma?) - Don't be sad; buy another one. Isn't there a big shopping mall outside the east gate of the company?
但是我这个月信用卡里的钱已经花得差不多了。 (Dànshì wǒ zhège yuè xìnyòngkǎ li de qián yǐjīng huā de chà bu duō le.) - But the money on my credit card this month has almost all been spent.
Lesson 20 Text 2: 在教室 (In the classroom)
你怎么突然关心起体育来了？ (Nǐ zěnme tūrán guānxīn qi tǐyù lai le?) - Why have you suddenly become interested in sports?
我的男朋友喜欢看足球比赛，我被他影响的。 (Wǒ de nánpéngyou xǐhuan kàn zúqiú bǐsài, wǒ bèi tā yǐngxiǎng de.) - My boyfriend likes watching football matches, and I've been influenced by him.
看来只有爱，才能让人有变化。 (Kànlái zhǐyǒu ài, cái néng ràng rén yǒu biànhuà.) - It seems only love can make people change.
是啊，为了和他的爱好一样，我天天看球赛。 (Shì a, wèile hé tā de àihào yíyàng, wǒ tiāntiān kàn qiúsài.) - Yes, to share the same hobby as him, I watch ball games every day.
除了足球，他还影响你什么了？ (Chúle zúqiú, tā hái yǐngxiǎng nǐ shénme le?) - Besides football, what else has he influenced you in?
我最近天天上网玩儿游戏，我的成绩差极了。 (Wǒ zuìjìn tiāntiān shàng wǎng wánr yóuxì, wǒ de chéngjì chà jí le.) - Lately I've been going online to play games every day, and my grades are terrible.
Lesson 20 Text 3: 在饭馆 (In the restaurant)
那个拿着碗吃饭的人是你哥哥吗？ (Nàge názhe wǎn chī fàn de rén shì nǐ gēge ma?) - Is that person eating with a bowl in hand your older brother?
他和你长得真像。 (Tā hé nǐ zhǎng de zhēn xiàng.) - He looks really like you.
我们经常被别人认错。 (Wǒmen jīngcháng bèi biérén rèncuò.) - We are often mistaken for each other by other people.

只有你们的爸爸妈妈才能分出来哪个是哥哥，哪个是弟弟吧。 (Zhǐyǒu nǐmen de bàba māma cái néng fēn chulai nǎge shì gēge, nǎge shì dìdi ba.) - Only your parents can tell which one is the older brother and which one is the younger brother.
除了父母以外，还有我们自己也能啊。 (Chúle fùmǔ yǐwài, hái yǒu wǒmen zìjǐ yě néng a.) - Besides our parents, we ourselves can too.
你们两个除了长得像，还有什么相同的地方？ (Nǐmen liǎng ge chúle zhǎng de xiàng, hái yǒu shénme xiāngtóng de dìfang?) - Besides looking alike, what else do the two of you have in common?
我们住在同一个楼、同一个房间…… (Wǒmen zhù zài tóng yí ge lóu, tóng yí ge fángjiān……) - We live in the same building, in the same room...
Lesson 20 Text 4: 年轻人遇到难题 (Young people facing difficult problems)
年轻人遇到难题，常常很着急，不知道怎么办。 (Niánqīng rén yùdào nántí, chángcháng hěn zháojí, bù zhīdào zěnme bàn.) - When young people meet difficult problems, they often get anxious and don't know what to do.
其实，不同的问题有不同的解决办法。 (Qíshí, bù tóng de wèntí yǒu bù tóng de jiějué bànfǎ.) - Actually, different problems have different solutions.

有些问题看上去很难，但是做起来非常简单，所以得试着做做。 (Yǒuxiē wèntí kàn shangqu hěn nán, dànshì zuò qilai fēicháng jiǎndān, suǒyǐ děi shìzhe zuòzuo.) - Some problems look very difficult but are very simple to actually do, so you have to try doing them.
有些问题看上去虽然简单，但是解决起来难极了。 (Yǒuxiē wèntí kàn shangqu suīrán jiǎndān, dànshì jiějué qilai nán jí le.) - Some problems look simple, but are extremely difficult to solve.
所以只有真正做事情的时候，才能了解有多难。 (Suǒyǐ zhǐyǒu zhēnzhèng zuò shìqing de shíhou, cái néng liǎojiě yǒu duō nán.) - So only when you really do things can you understand how difficult they are.
不过，我们一定要相信：多么难的问题，都会被解决的。 (Búguò, wǒmen yídìng yào xiāngxìn: dōume nán de wèntí, dōu huì bèi jiějué de.) - However, we must believe that no matter how difficult a problem is, it will be solved.
我被男朋友影响了。 (Wǒ bèi nánpéngyou yǐngxiǎng le.) - I was influenced by my boyfriend.
帽子被刮跑了。 (Màozi bèi guā pǎo le.) - The hat was blown away.
蛋糕让弟弟吃完了。 (Dàngāo ràng dìdi chīwán le.) - The cake was eaten up by my younger brother.
我的照相机被谁拿走了？ (Wǒ de zhàoxiàngjī bèi shéi názǒu le?) - Who has taken my camera?
问题还没有被解决呢。 (Wèntí hái méiyǒu bèi jiějué ne.) - The problem hasn't been solved yet.
病人还没被送到医院呢。 (Bìngrén hái méi bèi sòngdào yīyuàn ne.) - The patient hasn't been sent to the hospital yet.
下个月她会被妈妈送到美国。 (Xià ge yuè tā huì bèi māma sòngdào Měiguó.) - Next month she will be sent to America by her mother.
我们经常被别人认错。 (Wǒmen jīngcháng bèi biérén rèncuò.) - We are often mistaken for each other by other people.
